description: This PHP source file defines the ApplyLeaveController class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. The class manages leave application UI components, specifically preparing data related to work shift timings for rendering in a Vue.js component. It interacts with services and traits for user authentication, work schedule retrieval, and date-time formatting.

classes.name: ApplyLeaveController
classes.description: Controller class managing leave application front-end component rendering and data preparation, including work shift timings for the authenticated user.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for leave application by setting work shift time properties based on the user's schedule.
